nodes.description: Governance address state variable in ERC20, initialized to tx.origin; used as the sole authority for minting.
Boolean flag in TetrisFinance controlling whether transfers are enabled.
Mapping of account balances updated by _mint and _transfer.
Total token supply increased by _mint without cap enforcement in this path.
ERC20 constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals and assigns governance = tx.origin.
Non-standard public function that requires msg.sender == governance and then mints arbitrary tokens via _mint.
ERC20 transfer entry guarded by canTransfer modifier.
ERC1363 function that performs transferFrom then triggers an external receiver callback.
Internal helper that invokes onTransferReceived on the recipient contract and validates the magic value.
tx.origin used to set governance, enabling phishing-based privilege acquisition.
msg.sender used in authorization checks such as governance comparison and role checks.
Unrestricted mint call inside transferFromAndCall that creates tokens bypassing cap and role checks.
External call to onTransferReceived on an attacker-controlled recipient contract.
Recipient address of the minted tokens in transferFromAndCall.
Amount of tokens minted in transferFromAndCall.
Return value of the external onTransferReceived callback compared with the ERC1363 magic value.

edges.reason: tx.origin is assigned to the governance state variable in the constructor, making a phishing-susceptible input the authorization authority.
ERC20 constructor reads tx.origin to derive the governance account.
The governance state variable is read in transferFromAndCall as the only authorization check.
msg.sender is compared against governance to gate the privileged minting path.
A governance-gated (or tx.origin-derived) call reaches the unrestricted mint operation.
The unsafe mint operation invokes the internal _mint function.
fromAddress parameter flows into transferFromAndCall as the mint recipient.
SubstractedValue parameter flows into transferFromAndCall as the mint amount.
fromAddress controls the beneficiary of the mint operation.
SubstractedValue controls the quantity minted by the unsafe operation.
_mint writes the increased balance into the _balances mapping.
transferFromAndCallData calls the internal _checkAndCallTransfer helper after moving tokens.
_checkAndCallTransfer performs an external callback onTransferReceived on the recipient contract.
msg.sender is passed as the operator argument into the external callback.
The external callback returns retval which is validated against the ERC1363 magic value.
msg.sender is evaluated by the canTransfer modifier on the transfer entry point.
_transferEnabled state variable is read by the canTransfer modifier guarding transfer.
transferFromAndCallData internally performs a transfer that resolves to the transfer entry point logic.

normalization_plan.reason: The fromAddress parameter has no independent meaning and is only used as the mint recipient inside transferFromAndCall.
The SubstractedValue parameter is only consumed as the amount passed to the mint operation.
retval is a temporary result of the external callback used only to validate the magic value inside _checkAndCallTransfer.
